_comment: A RECORDED AgentDojo result, transcribed from evals/agentdojo FINDINGS (the gpt-4o-mini run, the first with baseline ASR > 0). Unlike the gauntlet/resolution traces, this is NOT regenerated by demos/build_demo — it needs a live model + OpenAI key. Re-run the evals/agentdojo harness to refresh these numbers, then update this file. Kept as data (not hardcoded in the page) so the provenance stays explicit and the snapshot is one place to update.
label: Recorded run · gpt-4o-mini · AgentDojo banking · important_instructions attack
bridge: The model fell for half the injections. Every divergent call it then tried — the attacker's IBAN, the tampered amount — produced “Execution context does not match the approved Cart”: check 07, context binding. The same check you just watched stop a substitution in the gauntlet.
provider_note: Oracle is the ceiling: perfect enforcement, zero false positives. The enrichments trade differently — policy turns four wrong amounts into bounded leaks to an allowlisted vendor (the attacker's IBAN is blocked every time), prompt-only stays conservative and routes two underspecified tasks to human review. ASR is 0.00 in every mode, because reaching the attacker requires money to land at the attacker's IBAN — which never happens.
provenance: Recorded run — not regenerated by this page (it needs a live model). Reproduce with the evals/agentdojo harness and an OpenAI key. Source: FINDINGS §9.
